full_prompt_en: A square monochrome fantasy illustration on aged cream paper centers an older wanderer in a broad, soft hat, surrounded by ravens, skulls, and twisting ornamental smoke. A solid black rectangular field sits behind the crowded scene, leaving a generous pale paper margin around it. The wanderer's head rises near the center, tilted slightly upward; the hat brim casts a dark crescent over his eyes while careful stippling and fine hatching model his nose, white beard, and weathered cheek. A tied scarf, layered coat, and crossing straps fill the lower middle with folds and small seams. One raven perches at the upper left and another spreads its wings at the upper right, breaking the rectangle's top boundary. Three skulls of different scale emerge from the tangle, one at left and two at right, their deep eye sockets and cracked bone surfaces rendered in precise dark marks. Flowing tendrils loop around every major form and spill over the edge of the black field onto the paper. The composition is dense but hierarchical: the face and hat are the largest central anchor, the birds make a high arch, and the pale skulls form lateral and low points of emphasis. Nearly every contour contains fine pencil-like shading, crosshatched shadow, and thin engraved lines. The cream paper shows a subtle grain, while the deep black backing gives the pale drawing a striking tonal platform. Light is implied through white paper left in raised surfaces, not through a visible lamp; shadow pools beneath the brim and inside folds, cavities, and feathers. The whole image feels ornate and slightly macabre, with a disciplined ink-and-graphite craft holding its elaborate forms together.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅绘在旧奶油色纸上的方形单色奇幻插画，以一名戴宽软帽的年长旅人为中心，周围围着渡鸦、颅骨和扭曲装饰烟雾。拥挤景象后方是一块纯黑矩形，四周留有宽裕的浅纸边。旅人的头在中央附近升起，略微仰起；帽檐在眼部投下一道暗弯月，精细点描与排线刻画鼻子、白胡须和饱经风霜的脸颊。打结围巾、层叠外套与交叉背带以褶皱和小接缝填满中下部。一只渡鸦停在左上，另一只在右上张翼，打破矩形的上边界。三个尺度不同的颅骨从缠绕形体中浮出，一个在左，两个在右；深陷眼眶与裂纹骨面由精确暗线呈现。流动卷须绕过所有主要形体，并越过黑色底框溢到纸面。构图密集却有层级：面孔与帽子是最大的中央锚点，鸟形成高处拱弧，浅色颅骨构成两侧和下方重点。几乎每条轮廓内都有铅笔般的细明暗、交叉排线和纤细刻线。奶油纸有轻微颗粒，深黑背板为浅色绘画提供鲜明的明暗平台。光通过隆起表面保留的纸白来暗示，而非由可见灯源发出；阴影积在帽檐下和衣褶、空腔、羽毛内部。整幅图华丽而略带阴森，严谨的墨线与石墨手艺把复杂形体维系在一起。
style_prompt_en: An intricate monochrome ink-and-graphite illustration sits on warm ivory paper against a compact, nearly solid black inset. Fine stippling, delicate contour lines, dense crosshatching, and engraved-looking strokes build volume within an unusually crowded cluster. Pale forms project past the inset boundary into the surrounding margin, so the outer edge feels porous and ornamental rather than neatly boxed. Large central tonal masses organize many smaller curling tendrils and featherlike or bone-smooth textures. The value range runs from untouched cream to deep black, with an especially rich middle register created by repeated minute marks. Light is inferred from retained paper highlights on raised areas; recesses receive concentrated shadow without a visible source. A high curved cluster, lateral pale accents, and a weightier lower mass create a compact but readable hierarchy. The texture is meticulous, aged, and tactile, allowing decorative complexity to accumulate while the central dark field and broad paper border keep the composition legible.
style_prompt_zh: 精密的单色墨线与石墨插画坐落在暖象牙纸上，背后嵌着一块紧凑、近乎纯黑的底色。细点描、纤弱轮廓线、密集交叉排线和如刻版般的笔痕，在异常拥挤的形体簇中建立体积。浅色形状越过黑底边界伸进周围留白，因此外缘显得多孔而装饰性强，并非整齐封箱。大型中央明暗体块组织许多较小卷须，以及羽状或骨面般平滑的纹理。明度从未触碰的奶油纸白延伸到深黑，丰富的中间调由反复微小笔痕建立。光通过隆起区域保留的纸白推断，凹处聚集深影，却没有可见光源。高处弯曲簇群、两侧浅色点缀与更重的下部体量组成紧凑但可读的层级。纹理细密、古旧且有触感，让装饰复杂度不断积累，同时由中央黑色底域和宽纸边维持清楚构图。
theme_en: An old wanderer surrounded by ravens, skulls and curling ornamental smoke
theme_zh: 一名年长旅人被渡鸦、颅骨与卷曲装饰烟雾围绕
name: Joe Fenton
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
